display_label: Kilimanjaro · summit window above sea level
note: Actual Kibo summit terrain, sampled from Mapzen Terrarium tiles on a 50 m grid, with no vertical exaggeration or summit correction. The authored 6.4 km square is a crop around the summit crater, not the full Kilimanjaro massif. The sides extend straight down to a sea-level display datum; they are arbitrary cuts, not cliffs, measured rock walls or the mountain’s base. Calibration uses TANAPA’s 5,895 m above-sea-level reference; the sampled grid maximum is about 5,886 m and is deliberately not forced to that reference. Elevation colors are illustrative, not observed geology, current snow or glacier boundaries. Mapzen / Tilezen; global SRTM and GMTED2010 terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.
